The powerful, modular software platform for automation tasks
autoEdition3 is an automation software program that is used in all our automated testing systems. It controls, regulates, and monitors specimen handling, the automated processes for measurements and tests as well as the data storage of test results. As with all our materials testing machines, the test itself is managed by our testXpert testing software. It can be used across all industries and is specially designed for a wide range of automated materials testing tasks.

Minimal training required
Immediately upon starting autoEdition3 automation software, the user experiences the benefits of intuitive operation from a look and feel that is consistent with the user interface for the testXpert testing software.
Intelligent features
With our many years of experience in automating materials testing machines, autoEdition3 offers numerous features that improve throughput, functionality, and the reproducibility of test results.
Future viability
The interfaces of the autoEdition3 automation software enable easy integration into smart labs or other higher-level systems.
Expandability
The modular software design of autoEdition3 extends the lifecycle of your automated testing system For example, adaptations and expansions to meet future testing requirements—such as adding devices or test stations—can be easily implemented. Even outdated automation systems can be upgraded and expanded with the latest software versions and electronics.
Reliable test results
In combination with our testXpert testing software, the autoEdition3 automation software delivers traceable and tamper-proof results. Simple backup and restore functions via our workflow wizard or 1 Click Image ensure secure data storage. Optionally, test results are quickly and easily available across platforms via visualization.
Data interface
To communicate with your existing LIMS system or databases, autoEdition usesASCII or ODBC as standard. Customer-specific interfaces such as OPC, REST, or Oracle can also be implemented upon request.
Industry 4.0
The autoEdition3 automation software was developed with a basis on the fundamentals and principles of Industry 4.0 and cyber-physical systems (CPS).
A look inside autoEdition: Screenshots of the automation software
Start screen
On the main screen of autoEdition3, the operator can navigate directly to the corresponding menus with the same look and feel as the testXpert testing software.
Specimen Office
Specimen Office serves as the central control hub for managing automation tasks. It allows the operator to create new specimens for testing and provides a quick overview of all specimens including their current status.
Data logger
The data logger automatically writes the individual automation steps to a corresponding log file, which can be used for analysis by the operator or, in the event of an error, by the support team.
Processed specimens
All specimens have been processed and the robot is ready for new test jobs.
